Welcome.cardCategoriesContent: A second GraphQL demo example, mirroring the Channels one, for this Project’s Category tree.
Welcome.cardChannelsContent: Demo example to fetch some data using GraphQL and displaying it in a paginated table.
Welcome.cardCustomObjectsContent: Browse, create, edit, and delete Custom Objects by container — arbitrary JSON data with no dedicated Merchant Center UI of its own.
Welcome.cardCustomerSupportContent: Look up a customer by email to see their profile, orders, and active cart, and leave an internal support note.
Welcome.cardDesignSystemContent: Explore the UI components to develop Custom Applications and learn more about the Design System.
